name: Border Galois
source:
A regular participant of the Toushin Tournament.
A tough warrior who is one of the contenders for the championship every year.
Bold, kind, and reliable uncle who likes to fight strong opponents.
He doesn't seem to like young girls, so even if he wins a match but their partner is too young, he only makes her pour the drinks.
If he found a woman of his type, he will apparently hit them to the bed.
